evals.prompt: /project-init base-only. Quero criar um repositório novo só com as convenções base em ./hello-base.
evals.expected_output: Resolves `base-only` as the `_base` alias, scaffolds only base files, and recommends CASA plus any selected optional tools without trying to resolve a family directory.

evals.prompt: Start a new TypeScript project in ./ts-app using the default TypeScript template.
evals.expected_output: Resolves `_base` plus `typescript`, scaffolds layered files, and recommends only the TypeScript dependency stack without duplicate optional-tool installs for required packages.

evals.prompt: /project-init typescript/node para um projeto chamado api-core em ./api-core.
evals.expected_output: Resolves `_base` -> `typescript` -> `typescript/node`, prints exactly one framework-init command (`pnpm init`), and keeps inherited concerns that the node layer does not override.

evals.prompt: /project-init typescript/vite para um app frontend. Quero React.
evals.expected_output: Asks for or respects the selected Vite framework template, uses `pnpm create vite . --template react-ts`, and keeps the instruction about handling non-empty directories before running the framework CLI.

evals.prompt: Create a Bun project in ./bun-service and include turbo plus lint-staged.
evals.expected_output: Merges optional tools by tool id, uses Bun-specific install commands for the selected tools, and does not replace inherited optional tools by accident.

evals.prompt: /project-init typescript into ./existing-dir, which already has files inside.
evals.expected_output: Checks whether the target directory is non-empty, lists conflicting paths, and asks for explicit approval before overwriting scaffolded files.
